[`RelativeDateValue`](RelativeDateValue.md)

## RelativeDateValue class

[Value](docs/obsidian_docs/obsidian_dev_docs/en/Reference/TypeScript%20API/Value.md) wrapping a Date. RelativeDateValue behaves the same as a [DateValue](DateValue.md) however it renders as a time relative to now.

 1.10.0

**Signature:**

```typescript
export class RelativeDateValue extends DateValue 
```
**Extends:** [`DateValue`](DateValue.md)
